notes.title: Version Update Announcement 2025/9/25
notes.notes: [p]Version Update Announcement 2025/9/25[/p][p]\[New Weapon][/p][p]MP7[/p][p]Fires 4.6x30mm rounds, compact and agile, featuring an extremely high Fire Rate and exceptional Mobility, capable of delivering powerful performance in confined spaces.[/p][p]Equipped with the new BAS Attachment "Heavy Trigger," which slightly reduces the MP7's Fire Rate but provides exceptional Recoil control and additional headshot Damage.[/p][p]Increase your Strike Pass level to try out this new SMG and rain down its bullets in matches!				[/p][p]\[Weapon Balance][/p][p]UMP45[/p][p]Headshot Damage: 46 → 39[/p][p]Limb Damage: 31 → 25[/p][p]MP5[/p][p]· Upper Chest Damage: 23 → 24[/p][p]· Lower Chest Damage: 23 → 24[/p][p]QBZ95[/p][p]Headshot Damage: 37 → 40[/p][p]M82[/p][p]The M82's relatively high recoil makes it difficult to consistently utilize its damage potential. We aim to enhance its competitiveness by increasing its damage ceiling.[/p][p](Heavy Barrel) Headshot Damage: 225 -> 250[/p][p](Heavy Barrel) Upper Chest Damage: 125 -> 150				[/p][p]Vector[/p][p]· Upper Chest Damage: 19 → 17[/p][p]· Abdominal Damage: 19 → 15[/p][p]· Lower Chest Damage: 19 → 15[/p][p]KAG-6[/p][p]· Headshot Damage: 26 → 28[/p][p]AK47[/p][p]· Upper Chest Damage: 30 → 32[/p][p]\[Elite Airdrop New Weapon][/p][p]Flamethrower[/p][p]Use it to unleash blazing flames and join a fun-filled barbecue party![/p][p]\[Slide Optimization][/p][p]We have received substantial player feedback and decided to postpone adjustments to speed decay after ""infinite slide"" movement, and gradually optimize it.[/p][p]Our commitment remains delivering engaging and strategically deep combat experiences. [/p][p]We'll continue focusing on optimizing unintended movement exploits that compromise competitive fairness.[/p][p]Moving forward, we'll closely monitor the actual impact of ""infinite slide"" movement within the current battle meta."			[/p][p]\[Ranked System][/p][p]1. Added a ranking progression acceleration system. Engage in battles on specific maps daily to earn extra Battle Royale ranking points.[/p][p]2. The M4A1-Ironsurgency will be available in the Ranked Store starting October 15. Redeem it permanently for 15,000 Ranked Coins![/p][p]3. The FAL-warrior Ultra Lucky Chest is now available, costing only 60 Ranked Coins per draw! It will be purchasable after the update on October 15.[/p][p]4. The FAL-warrior will be available in the Ranked Store starting October 15 at a limited-time discount. Redeem it permanently for 6,000 Ranked Coins. The price will return to the original 15,000 Ranked Coins on October 31.[/p][p]\[Squad Fight Adjustments][/p][p]The following changes will undergo pioneer testing in \[Squad Fight - Matchmaking] after the version update. They will be implemented in \[Squad Fight - Ranked] during Season 13.[/p][p]1. The Squad Fight store will no longer sell low-quality firearms and will instead offer more high-quality firearms.[/p][p]2. The overall firearm prices in the Squad Fight store have been reduced, allowing players to explore more firearm and item purchasing strategies.[/p][p]3. The Squad Fight store has added new firearms: M1887, Uzi, UMP45, FN2000, Galil, QBZ95, SVD, and RPK.[/p][p]4. The Squad Fight store has added special attachment firearms, Akimbo, Dragon's Breath Rounds, and more powerful attachments, which will randomly appear in the firearms sold in the store.			[/p][p]\[Weapon Level Up][/p][p]The INP-9 SMG and MP7 SMG will reach a weapon level of 100.[/p][p]The INP-9 SMG is getting a new BAS attachment, the "30-Round Armor-Piercing Magazine," while the MP7 SMG is receiving a new BAS attachment, the "Heavy Trigger." You can level up your weapons or unlock the new BAS attachments in the new BP "Iron Honor."			[/p][p]\[Vehicle System][/p][p]1. Vehicle interaction interface optimization: We have improved the vehicle's health display and fuel level indicators, and added a new preset driving key layout set for vehicles.[/p][p]2. Vehicle driving functionality optimization: A handbrake button has been added to the mobile version, consistent with the functionality on the PC version.[/p][p]3. Vehicle sound effects optimization: When the vehicle's fuel level is low, a distinct low fuel warning sound will be played.			[/p][p]\[Tournament System][/p][p]1. Added push notifications to prevent players from missing event schedules (Note: This feature requires enabling push notifications in the system settings).[/p][p]2. Added more in-game reminders to prevent players from missing event schedules.[/p][p]3. Optimized the performance during event processes.[/p][p]4. Optimized various host controls within event rooms.[/p][p]\[Skyline Beach][/p][p]The grand Dead Party will begin on October 10th![/p][p]1. The beautiful Skyline Beach has started its festive decorations. Welcome everyone to Skyline Beach to experience the holiday atmosphere![/p][p]2. Fixed issues with missing collision volumes in certain scene areas.[/p][p]3. Optimized the number of supply crates spawned in the late stages of matches.[/p][p]\[Active Event][/p][p]The Weapon Voting Event is back! This time, the two contenders are: the compact yet powerful M93R, and the epitome of elegance and brutality—S868! Who will emerge victorious in this showdown and make their way into the game? It’s all up to your choice![/p][p]\[New Arrivals][/p][p]1. Eternal-grade weapon skin \[AK47 - Chiaroscuro] will return for a limited time on September 25 as part of the \[Chiaroscuro Valor]! Light and dark shine together, the world is boundless, and all things radiate brilliance![/p][p]2. The brand-new Ultra-grade weapon skin \[Spear - Iridian] will be unlocked on September 26 in the \[Iridian Stash]. A dark purple beam condenses into the spear's tip, with deep-sea alloy and futuristic energy circuits cascading and surging. The weapon's body tears through the dark veil with every motion, as explosive purple lightning entwines it.[/p][p]3. The brand-new Eternal-grade weapon skin \[UMP - Infinite] will be available for a limited time starting October 3 in the \[Infinite Valor]! The sacred white and gilded gun body is engraved with ancient clock runes, and its flowing energy core pulses like the heart of time and space. It reforges the laws of battlefield chronology with its gunfire. Calibrate your tactical clock now, and in the instant you pull the trigger—become the master of time and space![/p][p]4. The brand-new Eternal-grade melee weapon skin \[Chainblade - Chainflux] will join the \[Chainflux Valor] on October 10, tearing through the void's curtain! The silver blade carries the tremors of energy tides, while cyan-green frostbeam condenses into chaotic string marks along its swing trajectory. The moment of execution triggers a whirlpool resembling a collapsing nebula, etching eternal scars in time and space with the futuristic blade![/p][p]5. The brand-new EVO-grade weapon skin \[Galil - Reaper] will be available for a limited time in the \[Reaper Valor] starting October 17! The shattered dark metallic gun body is adorned with jagged bone spikes, while the moon's energy dances across the metal surface. Amid the crisp sound of shell casings hitting the ground, witness the dual pact of the Reaper and Bleach—tonight, your gunfire is the crescent moon that harvests souls.			[/p][p]\[New Strike Pass] [/p][p]The "Iron Honor" Pass is coming soon, scheduled for release on October 15. [/p][p]By upgrading the free version of the Strike Pass, you can unlock the new MP7 weapon, along with free attachments MP7 - Heavy Trigger and INP-9 - 30-round Armor-Piercing Magazine, as well as the Street Art Camo Lucky Chest (Phase 1).[/p][p]Purchase and upgrade the Elite Strike Pass to receive an additional reward of 520 Gold, the emote "Love at First Sight," the Ultra Zero skin "Haze Blaze," MP7 - Specterstrike, M1887 - Specterstrike, and the execution move "Sun Fist Strike." Also included are Epic skins RAN - Crimson Heart and Katya - Crimson Heart. Plus, more chest rewards featuring vehicles, executions, and more are waiting for you! [/p][p]Purchase and upgrade the Premium Strike Pass to unlock the new Ultra KAG-6 Skin "Voltique," along with many more exciting rewards waiting for your exploration!			[/p][p]\[In-Game Adjustment][/p][p]1. Optimized the issue where the icon was too large after picking up the mission in point capture.[/p][p]2. To ensure consistency in combat experience across multiple maps, we have adjusted the weapons carried during late-stage revival in \[The Valley] to match those of other maps.[/p][p]3. With the conclusion of \[Skyline Beach], the airplane in Battle Royale Mode has also been restored to its original state.[/p][p]\[System Optimizations][/p][p]1. Based on players' enthusiasm, we have decided to grant all players the ability to create rooms for free starting September 29. Fast, call your friends and fight together for an exciting experience![/p][p]2. A new teammate "Not Ready" prompt has been added. When your teammate is taking too long to get ready, tapping "Start" will prompt them to enter the ready state.[/p][p]3. The \[Highlight Moments] system now includes the Squad Fight Mode, allowing you to view your standout performances in recent Squad Fight matches.[/p][p]4. A new rotation for Entertainment Modes has been added. We have integrated some entertainment modes together, and they will rotate every half hour.[/p][p]5. The display effect when sharing screenshots has been optimized.[/p][p]6. Optimized the display of Steam avatars for players logging in via Steam[/p][p]7. Optimized the display of the daily first win badge in the lobby.[/p][p]Thank you to all Strikers for your continued support. Stay tuned for more exciting content in upcoming announcements![/p][p]Blood Strike Development Team			[/p]

notes.notes: [p]【New Weapon】[/p][p]M82[/p][p]M82 Anti-Materiel Sniper Rifle: Fires the powerful .50 BMG ammunition, featuring various specialized rounds and a wide array of attachments. If one shot doesn't take down your enemy, just fire another.[/p][p]Equip the new BAS attachment "High Precision Laser" to transform the M82 into a close-quarters combat weapon, unleashing devastating power in tight spaces.[/p][p]Increase your Strike Pass level to try out this new sniper rifle and rain down its bullets in matches![/p][p]【New Gameplay】[/p][p]Elite Airdrop is about to make a powerful debut in Battle Royale Mode, featuring globally limited random drops of weapons like grenade launchers, M16s, Gatling close-defense cannons, and flamethrowers. Will players who seize the "Elite Airdrop" dominate the War Tide or become the hunted? The choice is yours![/p][p]【KAINDA Optimizations】[/p][p]KAINDA[/p][p]Skill Adjustments[/p][p]Phasing Arrow[/p][p]Horizontal range increased from 8m to 10m, cooldown reduced from 60s to 45s[/p][p]Scouting Arrow[/p][p]The range increases from a radius of 10 meters to 12 meters, and the cooldown decreases from 45 seconds to 35 seconds.[/p][p]【Rank Adjustment】[/p][p]Break through limits and reach the pinnacle! The all-new Tier system will launch in Season 13.[/p][p]1. Above the \[Legend] tier, a brand new \[Peak Legend] tier has arrived. Compete for exclusive Emote rewards reserved for the strongest![/p][p]2. The \[Legend] tier will be divided into four sub-tiers, ranging from Legend 4 to Legend 1.[/p][p]3. Slightly increased the match point consumption for the \[Legend] tier.[/p][p]【Stamp Collection Event】[/p][p]Stamp Collection Event is now live! Get the Ultra-quality Blast Striker skin for free! Complete weekly Missions to earn stamps. Use stamps to fill designated rows or columns and claim rewards including Noble Coins, Gold Bar Stash Vouchers, and more. Fill all stamps to receive the Blast Ultra-quality Striker skin. Event Duration: Sept 4 - Sept 30[/p][p]【Lucky Airdrop】[/p][p]Lucky Airdrop has arrived, with a chance to win up to 10,000 Noble Coins at once! Log in and stay Online during specific time slots to receive Lucky Airdrops. When activated, the Lucky Airdrop offers rewards like up to 10,000 Noble Coins, Gold Bar Stash Vouchers, and other prizes. Event Times: Sept 6, 7, 13, 14, 20, 21 | Daily 18:00:00 - 20:00:00[/p][p]【Tournament System Now Live】[/p][p]The Tournament System is now live! Step up and prove which squad is the strongest![/p][p]1. All players can access the tournament system through the Team - Tournament entry, where they can view available tournaments to register for in the list.[/p][p]2. Players must form a 4-member team to register for a tournament. After registration, they need to wait for the organizer to approve their application. Once approved, the team will be added to the tournament participant list.[/p][p]3. After the tournament registration deadline, the organizer can no longer add new participating teams or remove existing ones.[/p][p]4. When the tournament starts, the tournament room will be automatically created. All participants must join the room on time before the match begins. The tournament will then commence automatically.[/p][p]5. After the event concludes, the final rankings and star players will be determined based on the total points. Detailed point rules can be viewed in-game.[/p][p]6. Participate in events to earn league tokens as rewards, which can be exchanged for surprise rewards in the future. Stay tuned![/p][p]7. Currently, only select players can create events. If you wish to host one, please contact the official team.[/p][p]【KATYA Optimization】[/p][p]1. In the settings interface, under the "Gameplay" - "Move" tab, you can configure how KATYA enters wall climbing while airborne. The options are: automatic, hold jump, or tap jump again in mid-air. The default is hold to enter wall climbing.[/p][p]2. Enhanced the facial model of KAYTA.[/p][p]【Skyline Beach Optimization】[/p][p]1. Fixed the issue where collision volumes were missing in certain scene areas.[/p][p]2. Fixed issues with model clipping, misalignment, and texture flickering or loss in specific scenarios.[/p][p]3. Fixed issues that could cause Strikers to get stuck or accidentally fall out of the scene under extreme conditions.[/p][p]4. Enhanced the tactical experience in the War Tide battlefield by adding more trees and cover to the environment.[/p][p]5. Optimized the spawn quantity and distribution of certain supplies.[/p][p]6. Optimized vegetation to address frame rate drops some players experienced in wilderness environments[/p][p]\[Active Event][/p][p]1. The Firearms Academy opens on 9/15! Come experience the power of the new M82 rifle![/p][p]2. Complete daily Mission Pass missions to earn extra Pass XP! Event Duration: 9.15-9.28[/p][p]3. The Match Challenge event is live! Complete missions from 9/15 to 9/21 and 9/29 to 10/5 to earn free Gold Stash Vouchers.[/p][p]4. The Hero's Trial is here! Complete it from 9/22 to 9/28 to earn free Gold Stash Vouchers.[/p][p]5. The Weekly Activity Gift event is now live! Complete matches from 9/5 to 9/7, 9/12 to 9/14, and 9/19 to 9/21 to earn free Gold Stash Vouchers.[/p][p]【New Arrivals】[/p][p]1. The brand-new EVO-tier weapon skin \[KAG-6-Matrix] will be available for a limited time in the \[Matrix Valor] starting September 12! The dark red cube chassis fused with quantum blue light, adorned with gilded fractures resembling shattered timelines at its edges—every bullet fired rewrites the battlefield's Dimension. Log in now to unlock this transcendent symphony of violent aesthetics that defies causality.[/p][p]2. The all-new Ultra-tier weapon skin \[AUG-Aureate] joins the \[Aureate Stash] on September 5! Forged with the spirit of warriors, its barrel pulses with dark violet flames surging through gilded engravings. Each shot unleashes a torrent of phoenix-like purple fire, leaving scorched trails that sprawl like a demonic parade across bullet trajectories![/p][p]3. The latest Ultra-tier weapon skin \[Kukri-Nexora] slashes into the \[Nexora Stash] on September 19! Dark golden fractal patterns, etched like interstellar code onto hyper-titanium alloy blades, carve collapsing light trails akin to ruptured high-Dimension space with every swing. Each afterimage is a chaotic concerto of military engineering and brutal artistry![/p][p]\[New Strike Pass][/p][p]The "Rust Fall" Strike Pass is coming soon, scheduled for release on September 15.[/p][p]Upgrade through the free Strike Pass to unlock the new weapon M82, the free attachment M82-High Precision Laser, and the Street Art Camo Lucky Loot Box (Phase 1).[/p][p]Purchase and upgrade the Elite Strike Pass to additionally receive 520 Gold Bars, the Lead Emote - Stick Step, the Ultra Kainda skin "Fallout Gear," M82-Fallux, Origin-12-Fallux, and the Execution - Gun Grab. Epic skins JET-Depleted Uranium and LUCIAN-Depleted Uranium. Plus, more loot box rewards including vehicles, executions, and more await you![/p][p]Purchase and upgrade the Premium Strike Pass to unlock the new Ultra MP5 skin \[Fallux], along with many more exciting rewards![/p][p]【New in Store】[/p][p]1. Glock - Molten Core is now available in the Noble Coin store, don't miss out![/p][p]2. Adjusted the sales limit for Customize room cards in the store from a weekly cap of 5 to a daily cap of 3; price reduced from 3000 Reputation to 1000 Reputation.[/p][p]\[In-Game Optimizations][/p][p]1. Removed the Mission terminal from the map.[/p][p]2. Vehicle Adjustments: We've observed an increase in vehicle usage during Skyline Beach matches, so we've optimized the driving Controls for better handling.[/p][p]3. We've identified an abnormal Speed issue with the "Slide-Scope" maneuver, where it grants unintended initial momentum and bypasses the deceleration mechanic of consecutive slides.[/p][p]This issue will be fixed in the next version update.[/p][p]4. In Battle Royale Mode, the following ground weapons are now available to Pick Up: Uzi, FN2000, QBZ95, SVD, RPK, M1887, UMP45.[/p][p]5. Added "The Valley" as a new map for Hide and Seek.[/p][p]\[System Optimization][/p][p]1. Increased the maximum holding limit for Noble Coins[/p][p]2. Optimized the display of the 15-day newcomer check-in event[/p][p]3. Improved the visual effects of newcomer pathfinding[/p][p]4. Playpal's custom preview now supports one-click import of existing Playpal affixes[/p][p]5. Enhanced the newcomer tutorial in the Striker interface[/p][p]6. Optimized the display rules for some dropdown boxes.[/p][p]7. In \[Settings] - \[Sensitivity] - \[Slide] and \[Controller], added \[Tactical Stance] sensitivity settings for \[Camera Sensitivity] and \[Firing Sensitivity].[/p][p]8. Added "Firing Sensitivity" settings for the PC version.[/p][p]9. Added a \[Global Sensitivity Sync] toggle in sensitivity settings. When enabled, it synchronizes sensitivity adjustments for all sights.[/p][p]Thank you to all Strikers for your continued support. Stay tuned for more exciting content in upcoming announcements![/p][p]Blood Strike Development Team[/p][p]9/4/2025[/p]

notes.notes: [p]\[New Map - Skyline Beach][/p][p]Unlike the canyon-like valley terrain or the tropical island scenery of Demon Island, Costa Del Sol is situated in hilly terrain with scattered urban and industrial facilities. Crossing the bay bridge, the northern coast boasts natural sandy beaches. Strikers have noticed that the sky here sometimes displays unusual hues, and during flights, sounds of other high-speed flying objects can be heard. Could there be a connection between these phenomena? Explore more in \[Battle Royale], \[Squad Fight], and \[Hot Zone Showdown]![/p][p]\[Skyline Beach Bonus Month!][/p][p]New map is now live! Download now to claim the Event-tier \[URB - Evolved Viper], and upgrade it to permanent by participating in map exploration activities![/p][p]1. Starting August 14th, complete map exploration missions to claim exclusive rewards including Event-tier \[URB - Evolved Viper], Ultra character skin \[HANK-Thug], Thug series skins, limited Camo - Violet Wonderland, and special Event titles![/p][p]2. Log in to claim 70 free draws! Accumulate 20 login days starting August 14th to receive Eternal-tier \[Odashadow Stash Voucher ×70]—daily draws await![/p][p]3. The first free Epic melee skin—Golf Club! Invite 3 friends to help slash the price and claim it for free! Event duration: August 14th–24th.[/p][p]4. Invite friends for gold bars—bonus rewards! Successfully invite 3 friends to claim 500 gold bars & \[Odashadow Stash Voucher*20]. Invited friends also get \[Odashadow Stash Voucher*10] extra![/p][p]5. From August 23rd to 24th, log in to claim \[Overload Pulse Stash Voucher*5]. Complete Missions to earn an additional \[Gold Bar Stash Voucher*10].[/p][p]6. During the Skyline Beach Event, complete weekly Missions to receive Ultra Gacha Vouchers—who will land the One-Shot Wonder? Also, claim exclusive weekly rewards like Event Avatars, Event Name Cards, Event Parachutes, and more![/p][p]7. Weekend Bonus: Log in to grab Ultra Gacha Vouchers—this time for real! Activate Battle Privileges and team up with friends to climb ranks with ease.[/p][p]【New Weapon】[/p][p]Spear[/p][p]Fires 6.8x51mm ammunition with exceptionally high Bullet Velocity and surpasses other Rifles in effective Range.[/p][p]Equip the new BAS Attachment "2.0x Thermal Scope" to instantly locate your enemies in War Tide, leaving no place to hide even for those concealed by smoke grenades![/p][p]Increase your Strike Pass level to try out this new rifle and rain down its bullets in matches![/p][p]【New Striker】[/p][p]KATYA[/p][p]KATYA, a cold and agile Striker, rumored to be a descendant of the Iga ninja clan. She excels in using ninja tools and swift movements to gain the upper hand in combat and defeat her opponents.[/p][p]Arc Kunai[/p][p]Throws an arc kunai that detonates after a delay, dealing explosive damage and slowing the target.[/p][p]Phoenix Soaring Dance[/p][p]Perform a high-speed short dash. Additionally, KATYA can climb walls with slight movements.[/p][p]【Weapon Balancing】[/p][p]M1887[/p][p]Nerf the M1887's sustainability, requiring users to aim more precisely to ensure a Kill.[/p][p]- Reduce the capacity of all Magazines by 1 round.[/p][p]SVD[/p][p]Increase the one-shot kill limit[/p][p]- Incendiary Magazine, headshot damage increased to 225[/p][p]【Weapon Level Up】[/p][p]The Type MM-99 209mm AU Assault Rifle (M4A1) and Spear Rifle will reach weapon level 100.[/p][p]The Type MM-99 209mm AU Assault Rifle introduces a new BAS Attachment "Aluminum Alloy Stock," while the Spear Rifle unveils a new BAS Attachment "2.0x Thermal Scope." You can upgrade your weapon level or unlock brand-new BAS Attachments in the latest BP "Sakura Storm."[/p][p]【Ranking Optimization】[/p][p]Optimized the matchmaking logic for Legend-tier games, reducing the probability of newly promoted Legend players being matched against top-tier Legend players to ensure a better battle experience.[/p][p]We fully recognize the core value of the matchmaking system for competitive fairness. Future updates will continue to focus on the ranking and matchmaking systems.[/p][p]\[Active Event][/p][p]1. The Match Challenge event is live! Complete missions from 8/18 to 8/24 and 9/1 to 9/7 to earn free Gold Stash Vouchers.[/p][p]2. The Hero's Trial is here! Complete it from 8/25 to 8/31 and 9/8 to 9/14 to earn free Gold Stash Vouchers.[/p][p]3. The Weekly Activity Gift event is now live! Complete matches from 8/15 to 8/17, 8/22 to 8/24, and 8/29 to 8/31 to earn free Gold Stash Vouchers.[/p][p]\[New Strike Pass][/p][p]The "Sakura Storm" Strike Pass is coming soon, scheduled for release on August 15.[/p][p]Upgrade the free version of the Strike Pass to obtain the new weapon SPEAR, new Striker Katya, and a free vehicle skin, Off-road Car - Ice.[/p][p]Purchase and upgrade the Elite Strike Pass to unlock 520 Gold Bars, Playpal - Banana Cat, Ultra Katya skin "Geisha Gear," VSS - Pendulum of Fate, SPEAR - Pendulum of Fate, as well as the execution move – Life & Death Snipe, Epic skin Hank - Sakura Purple, VAL - Sakura Pink, plus additional crate rewards including vehicles, executions, and more![/p][p]Purchase and upgrade the Premium Strike Pass to unlock the new Ultra SVD skin "MistyTide," along with many more exciting rewards![/p][p]【New Arrivals】[/p][p]1. The new Eternal-tier character skin \[ZERO-Odashadow] will be available for a limited time in the \[Odashadow Valor] on August 14th! Inspired by the soul of a Warring States conqueror, its metal-plated armor is engraved with Gold family crests, dragging trails of Purple flames like a demon king's march—burning cities and breaking formations![/p][p]2. The new Eternal-tier weapon skin \[UZI-Scorpius] will debut for a limited time in the \[Scorpius Valor] on August 22nd! Forged in the image of a desert scorpion, its metallic chassis mimics mechanized exoskeleton plating, with a tail-like barb glowing with unquenchable crimson embers. Its Move leaves searing trails resembling a scorpion's crawl—lurking, waiting to tear through the War Tide![/p][p]3. The new Ultra-tier firearm skin \[M1887-Phantomrift] joins the \[Phantomrift Cache] on August 20th! Its barrel is etched with stellar debris patterns, while Supernova collapse ripples swirl into gravitational afterimages at the stock. Every shot releases an Energy Pulse of shattered starlight![/p][p]【Hide and Seek Gameplay Optimization】[/p][p]1. Added "Shutter Island" as a new hide-and-seek gameplay map.[/p][p]2. Added exclusive in-game background music for the new gameplay mode.[/p][p]3. Optimized the variety and quantity of models in gameplay scenes, now featuring more diverse models randomly appearing.[/p][p]4. Increased the duration of the seeker's skills.[/p][p]5. Added bonus points for seekers when eliminating hiders' decoys.[/p][p]6. Added a new mechanic where Seekers will respawn at their death location after a certain waiting time upon death.[/p][p]7. Adjusted the Seeker's initial weapon to the FAL.[/p][p]8. Optimized the visual feedback for Seekers when they earn bullets from kills.[/p][p]9. Expanded the variety of models Hiders can transform into.[/p][p]10. Added a new feature where Hiders gain extra points when they are within a certain distance of a Seeker.[/p][p]11. Hiders will be able to use the Clone skill during the hiding phase.[/p][p]12. Added cooldown time for Hider's Lock ability.[/p][p]13. Added free camera toggle for Hiders while spectating.[/p][p]14. Improved free camera performance—now you can hear sound effects from the current camera position.[/p][p]15. Fixed an issue where Seeker skill effects were not visible in kill replays.[/p][p]16. Fixed the missing rope key prompt issue on PC.[/p][p]17. Fixed an occasional issue where the scoreboard couldn't be opened.[/p][p]18. Fixed an occasional camera twitching issue after hiders were locked.[/p][p]19. Fixed occasional abnormal player animations during round transitions.[/p][p]20. Fixed an edge case where hiders couldn't see Kill notifications.[/p][p]21. Fixed an issue where hiders could get stuck by clones under extreme circumstances.[/p][p]22. Fixed an issue where hiders couldn't spectate after death under extreme circumstances.[/p][p]23. Fixed an issue where hiders could jump infinitely under extreme circumstances.[/p][p]【Gameplay Optimization】[/p][p]1. Optimized the AI logic in Hot Zone gameplay, reducing the negative experience of being instantly killed by AI when the score gap is too large.[/p][p]2. Improved the sprint animation effects for third-person pistol handling.[/p][p]3. For high Fire Rate firearms, optimized the muzzle smoke Effect to reduce the visual impact of screen flickering.[/p][p]4. Fixed performance issues with the SVD, enhancing its Smooth usage.[/p][p]5. Added an emergency teammate revival feature. When a match exceeds a certain duration and only one Team member remains alive, the required coins will be automatically consumed after a Short delay to fulfill revival requests.[/p][p]6. We've noticed the issue where Flash Grenades couldn't be countered during matches and have made optimizations: Now when players face away from the Flash Grenade, they will no longer be affected.[/p][p]\[System Optimization][/p][p]1. The new iteration of the Fast Airdrop Cache is now live, supporting quick buyback via the Cache; players can customize Cache functions in the settings.[/p][p]2. Optimized the display rules related to shield upgrades in different Modes.[/p][p]3. Fixed the issue on PC where dropped weapons in Squad Fight Mode would overlap with Loot Crates, making them difficult to Pick Up.[/p][p]4. Added quick-access buttons for weapon Modify on the pre-match loadout and inventory pages.[/p][p]5. Improved the in-game prompts when teammates request help with purchases in Squad Fight Mode.[/p][p]6. The Playpal system enables multi-set switching. Removed the "Firing Sensitivity" setting on PC. notes.notes: [p]\[Hide and Seek][/p][p]New entertainment Gameplay is here! In this Mode, players are divided into two teams—one can transform into objects to hide, while the other must find all the hidden players.[/p][p]The hiding team has two special skills: 1. Leave behind a decoy of their current transformed object to mislead the seekers. 2. Release a Flash Grenade on the spot to blind the seekers.[/p][p]The seeker possesses a tracking ability: can locate the direction of the nearest hider, but be aware that missing an attack on a hider will cost health points.[/p][p]There are three rounds in total. At a specific point in each round, hidden players will be forced to transform once. Additionally, near the end of each round, seekers will receive a powerful weapon and no longer consume ammo when firing! Both hiding for a certain duration as a hidden player or finding hidden players as a seeker will earn points. After three rounds, the player with the highest total score wins! Optimized the polygon count and rendering mode of map models to lower performance consumption.[/p][p]\[Pacing Adjustments][/p][p]We've noticed that players can easily acquire large amounts of gold, leading to overcrowding in the final circle. Therefore, the following adjustments have been made:[/p][p]Adjusted the amount of gold obtained from killing players[/p][p]\[Sound Optimization][/p][p]We observed that the warning for teleportation grenades during intense player battles was insufficient, so we've optimized the sound system for Thunder grenades.[/p][p]1. Visualized sound for teleportation grenades:[/p][p]When nearby enemy characters teleport, their arrival direction will be indicated on the screen.[/p][p]2. Increased the audible range of teleportation sound effects.[/p][p]【Playpal System Optimization】[/p][p]1. Playpal now supports sharing functionality. Improved the visual effects of the Tier Up pop-up window.[/p][p]4. Added probability-related information disclosure in Playpal's description.[/p][p]5. Improved the font display for the playtime of Playpals in the warehouse.[/p][p]8. You can now equip Playpals directly from the acquisition interface.[/p][p]【STRIKER Skill Cast Optimization】[/p][p]1.LUCIAN: Optimized the trigger method for "Feigned Slumber" teleportation. Players who are K.O.'d within the totem's range can now Tap to choose whether to teleport or not.[/p][p]2.KRAKEN: Optimized the flight path of the "Vortex" raven. Fixed the display error of the hand model for 【Nova Nightmare】 under extreme circumstances.[/p][p]2. His body has been implanted with specialized neural sensory amplifiers and bioelectric camouflage units, granting him extraordinary perception and a unique "pseudo-sleep" ability. By leveling up your firearm, you can unlock more Camo, crosshairs, Attachments, Weapon Master titles, and other rewards![/p][p]2. A new "Weapon Display Rack" has been added to the Training Ground. All weapons for which you have earned the "Weapon Master" title will be automatically displayed on the "Weapon Display Rack."[/p][p]4. The methods for gaining firearm experience have become more diverse, and the weapon experience acquisition rate across different Modes is now more balanced. Currently, the first BAS Attachment can be experienced on the M1887.[/p][p]\[Activities][/p][p]1. The Match Challenge event is live! Complete missions from 6/16 to 6/22 and 6/30 to 7/6 to earn free Gold Stash Vouchers.[/p][p]2. The Hero's Trial is here! The brand-new Eternal-grade weapon skin 【AK47-Overload】 will be available for a limited time starting June 20 in the 【Overload Eternal Valor】! Additionally, new Kill upgrade features await your exploration![/p][p]2. The brand-new Eternal-grade weapon skin 【KALA-Requiem】 will tear into the 【Requiem Eternal Valor】 starting June 27! Under the name of Oblivion, it shreds the rules of the War Tide![/p][p]4. If you have already logged into the game through Steam without linking your existing account, please note that this Steam account cannot be linked to your existing game account. For any questions, please contact our customer support team.

Please read the following steps to link your Steam account to your existing game account:
1. After logging into your account on the PC or mobile client, enter the game and click the "Settings" button.
2. In the settings menu, click the "Account" button in the top right corner.
3. Click "Bind Account".
4. Click "Bind Steam".

Once you have completed the process of linking your Steam account, you will be able to log into the game through Steam and continue playing with your existing account progress. Have fun!
